summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 1.10/368)

data.turoyo: U ḥa d xutamwo u Mgalyun, annaqqa yulafwo an naḥle di ʕito, hedi nufaqwo.
data.translation: And one who finished the Gospel would then learn the church melodies, and then leave.

rationale: New Infectum-wa box; habitual sequencing without another reading sense.

summary: New box Preterit-wa: example for sense 2 in Preterit-wa (Jan 1.31/1400)

data.turoyo: Qurewo ġalabe, xtəmwole i madrašto w aṯiwo l su babo.
data.translation: He used to study a great deal; he had finished school and had come to his father.

rationale: New Preterit-wa box, school object and subsequent arrival.

summary: New sense 2: to complete, finish (a course of study, military service, a period or proceedings)

data.gloss: to complete, finish (a course of study, military service, a period or proceedings)

rationale: Non-reading completion is explicit with i ʕaskariye, i madrašto and a measured duration. Schooling, service and concluding an event share completion; do not multiply technical senses by object type.

data.turoyo: Afandəm aḥna b Məḏyaḏ qrelan mi Olaf-Beṯ hul d xtəmlan u Mgalyun.
data.translation: Sir, we in Midyat studied from the Olaf-Beth [alphabet] until we finished the Gospel.

rationale: Thin Preterit reading cell has one p.c. example; connected curricular context.

data.turoyo: Bəṯər məd babi xtəmle i ʕaskariye, laf faransawiye zbəṭte Adana.
data.translation: After my father finished his military service, the French occupied Adana.

rationale: New non-reading completion sense, explicit service object.
New schooling participant under general completion; source case retained.

data.turoyo: Arbʕo w ḥamši yawme zəyude xtəmlan. Hul d aṯi u amro da tre, mərre: "Mraxesunne!"
data.translation: We completed fifty-four extra days, until the second order came and they said, ‘Discharge them!’

rationale: Duration object of completion in explicit discharge context; no separate duration sense.

data.turoyo: Hawən mamnun ġalabe. Hul d mkamelan hawxa, bəṯər xtəmoli naqla ḥreto. Dʕəlilən, haka əno kuhno.
data.translation: They were very pleased. Until we finished like this, afterwards I concluded it once again. They invited me, as a priest.

rationale: General completion with feminine object suffix and naqla ḥreto; proceedings referent is inferred, not a separate conclude-speech sense.

summary: Jan Beṯ-Şawoce has no edition translation. Supplied English is project machine translation, retained verbatim where quoted; semantic decisions rest on the Turoyo.
Existing English gloss To finish reading, is preserved exactly. New general completion is English too; no inherited wording or sense number is rewritten.
Preterit l-series xtəmlan/xtəmli contrasts with habitual xutamwo and anterior xtəmwole. xtəmme reflects a plural actor, but one-daughter discourse at Jan 2.2/89 leaves agreement uncertain.
Three xtəmli tokens at Jan 1.38/1598 are retained as three occurrence decisions, including the resumptive/restarted wording; only one short school example is selected.
No new light-verb idiom is required: xtm itself contributes completion across book, service, school, duration and anaphoric event objects.
Does completing school conventionally entail graduation or a diploma? Following šqəlle doblamat is independent evidence, not part of the proposed gloss.
Confirm plural xtəmme with ḥḏo at Jan 2.2/88–89; do not silently replace it with feminine xtəmla.
What is the feminine object of xtəmoli at Jan 2.12/2883? The supplied verse supports concluding an event, but speech/proceedings is an inferred referent.
Educational completion is recurrent; mi madrašto, direct school object, omitted course and teacher gabox vary. Diplomas at 1410 are a following predicate, not an entailment of xtm.
Measured duration and an anaphoric concluded event extend completion, not new temporal or speech-specific lexical senses.
